card.name: The word prepare in preparation instructions
card.fires_on: Forms of the word prepare (Prepare, prepared, preparation) in dosage and administration sections, mostly at the start of a preparation instruction or in a preparation heading.

modes.label: Instruction verb
modes.description: The verb prepare opens or sits inside a sentence telling the user how to make up a product.
